title.en: Linear Search with a for Loop
title.zh: 线性查找：for 循环逐个比

blurb.en: Look at every item in turn, give back the index of the first match - and only say "not here" once the whole list has been checked.
blurb.zh: 一个一个看过去，交回第一个相等元素的下标——而「不在」这句话，只能等整张表都看完才说。

en: Linear search is the simplest search there is: start at index 0 and compare every item with the target until one matches. It works on any list, sorted or not, and when there are repeats it finds the first one, because it starts from the left. The price is that in the worst case - the target is last, or missing - it looks at every item: time O(n).
The moment an item matches, the function hands back its index, and return ends the whole function there and then, loop and all. That is why the loop needs no break and no flag.

The not-found answer is -1, a number that can never be a real index. It must come after the loop, not inside it. A common slip is to give the if an else branch that hands back -1 straight away: then the function gives up as soon as the first item does not match, and a search for Grace in the demo would fail at Ada. Only once every item has been compared can you say the target is missing.
The demo finds the first Grace at index 2 (the second Grace at index 4 is never reached), gives -1 for Guido, 0 for Ada, and -1 for an empty list, where the loop body never runs at all.
zh: 线性查找是最朴素的查找：从下标 0 开始，把每个元素依次和目标比，直到遇上相等的。它对任何列表都管用，有序无序都行；有重复时它找到的是第一个，因为它从左边开始看。代价是最坏情况——目标在最后，或者根本不在——要把每个元素都看一遍：时间 O(n)。
一旦某个元素相等，函数就交回它的下标；return 当场结束整个函数，循环也一起结束。所以这个循环不需要 break，也不需要标志位。
找不到时交回 −1，一个不可能是真实下标的数。它必须写在循环后面，不能写在循环里。常见的错法是给那个 if 配一个 else 分支、当场交回 −1：这样第一个元素不相等，函数就放弃了——演示里找 Grace，会在 Ada 那里就失败。只有每个元素都比过了，才能说目标不在。
演示里找到的是第一个 Grace，下标 2（下标 4 的第二个 Grace 根本走不到）；找 Guido 得 −1，找 Ada 得 0；对空列表查找得 −1——循环体一次也不执行。

lineNotes.en: return leaves the function at once - the loop does not run to the end.
lineNotes.zh: return 立刻离开函数——循环不会再跑完。

blurb.en: Put the target on the end of a copy of the list, and the loop no longer has to check whether it has run off the end.
blurb.zh: 在列表副本的末尾放上目标本身，循环就不必每一步再问「是不是走过头了」。

en: An ordinary search loop asks two questions at every step: is there still an item here, and is it the target? The sentinel trick removes the first question. Put the target itself on the end of the list, and the scan is certain to stop - at the real target if it is there, or at the sentinel if it is not. The loop condition is then a single comparison.

When the loop stops, i says where. If it is less than n, the original length, a real item matched. If it equals n, the only thing found was the sentinel you put there yourself, so the answer is -1. The search is still O(n); the saving is one comparison per step, which mattered on old machines and still shows the idea of a guard value.

The sentinel goes on a copy, never on the caller's list. Appending to items directly would change the list that was passed in: the caller would find an extra item on the end after every search. list(items) makes a new list with the same items, and only that copy grows. The demo prints scores at the end and it is still the original five numbers.

In the demo 88 is found at index 2, 17 at index 1 (the first of the two), and 50 is not there, so the scan runs on to the sentinel and the answer is -1. An empty list works too: the copy holds only the sentinel, i stops at 0, which equals n, and the answer is -1.
zh: 普通的查找循环每一步都要问两句：这里还有元素吗？它是目标吗？哨兵的技巧去掉了第一句。把目标本身放到列表末尾，扫描就一定会停——目标在表里就停在真目标上，不在就停在哨兵上。于是循环条件只剩一个比较。
循环停下时，i 说明停在哪。它小于 n（原来的长度），说明撞上的是真元素；它等于 n，说明找到的只是自己放的哨兵，答案是 −1。查找仍是 O(n)；省下的是每步一次比较——在老机器上很值钱，今天也还能说明「守卫值」这个思路。
哨兵放在副本上，绝不放在调用者的列表上。直接往 items 末尾追加，会改掉传进来的那个列表：调用者每查一次，就发现表尾多了一个元素。list(items) 造出一个元素相同的新列表，只有这个副本变长。演示最后把 scores 打印出来，它仍是原来那五个数。
演示里 88 在下标 2 找到，17 在下标 1（两个 17 里的第一个）；50 不在，扫描一直走到哨兵，答案 −1。空列表也照样工作：副本里只有哨兵，i 停在 0，等于 n，答案 −1。

lineNotes.en: A new list with the same items - the caller's list is never touched.
lineNotes.zh: 一个元素相同的新列表——调用者的列表一点不动。

lineNotes.en: No bounds check here: the sentinel guarantees the loop stops by index n at the latest.
lineNotes.zh: 这里不查越界：哨兵保证循环最迟在下标 n 停下。

title.en: Linear Search That Stops Early in a Sorted List
title.zh: 有序表里提前停的线性查找

blurb.en: In a sorted list, the first item bigger than the target proves the target is missing - no need to walk to the end.
blurb.zh: 在有序表里，遇到第一个比目标大的元素，就证明目标不在——不必走到表尾。

en: If the list is sorted from small to large, every item after a bigger one is bigger still. So the first time the scan meets an item larger than the target, the target cannot appear later, and the search can give up right there instead of walking to the end.

There are now three ways out of the function: found it (its index), passed the place where it would have been (-1 at once), or ran off the end because every item was smaller (-1 after the loop). The two checks are separate ifs, but the first one returns, so the second is only reached when the item was not a match.

How much does it save? When the target is missing, the scan stops where the target would have been. If missing targets fall anywhere in the range with equal chance, that place is on average half-way along, so about half the comparisons are saved. It is still O(n): the saving is a constant factor, and a target bigger than everything still costs a full pass.

In the demo 13 is found at index 5. 12 is missing, and the scan stops at 13, the first prime above it. 1 is smaller than everything, so the very first item, 2, already ends the search. 31 is bigger than every prime in the list, so there is no early exit and the loop runs to the end.
Found targets cost the same as before: with repeats it still gives the first one.
zh: 列表从小到大排好时，一个大的元素后面只会更大。所以扫描第一次遇到比目标大的元素，目标就不可能在后面出现，查找可以当场放弃，不必走到表尾。
于是函数有三个出口：找到了（交回下标）；走过了它本该在的位置（当场 −1）；走完了整张表，因为每个元素都更小（循环后 −1）。两次判断是两个独立的 if，但第一个会 return，所以只有这个元素不相等时才走到第二个。
省了多少？目标不在时，扫描停在它本该在的位置。如果缺席的目标等可能地落在整个范围里，这个位置平均在一半处，所以比较次数大约省一半。它仍是 O(n)：省的只是常数倍，而比所有元素都大的目标照样要走完一整遍。
演示里 13 在下标 5 找到。12 不在，扫描停在 13——第一个比它大的质数。1 比谁都小，第一个元素 2 就结束了查找。31 比表里每个质数都大，没有提前停，循环一直走到表尾。
找得到的目标花的比较次数和原来一样；有重复时给的仍是第一个。

lineNotes.en: The early exit is only correct because this list is sorted.
lineNotes.zh: 提前停之所以对，全靠这个列表是有序的。

blurb.en: Compare with the middle item and throw away the half that cannot hold the target - lo, hi and mid in a closed range.
blurb.zh: 和中间那个比，扔掉不可能有目标的那一半——闭区间里的 lo、hi、mid。

en: Binary search only works on a sorted list. It keeps two indexes, lo and hi, marking the part of the list where the target could still be. Here the range is closed: both lo and hi are inside it, so it starts from 0 to the last index and holds one item when lo equals hi.

Each time round, mid is the middle index. If the item there is the target, done. If it is too small, the target can only be to its right, so the left end moves past mid; if too big, the right end moves to just before mid. Either way mid itself leaves the range. Leave it in and a range of two items can have mid land on the same place forever - an infinite loop.

When lo passes hi the range is empty and the target is not there: -1. Each step halves the range, so the time is O(log n). The ten-item list in the demo needs at most four comparisons; a list of a thousand items would need at most ten.

In the demo 41 is found at index 7, 3 at index 0 and 67 at index 9 (the two ends), while 20 falls between 15 and 21 and is not there, and an empty list gives -1 without entering the loop, because hi starts at -1. With repeated values this version returns whichever copy mid lands on first, not necessarily the first one - Binary Search for the First Match deals with that.
zh: 二分查找只对有序列表有效。它记两个下标 lo 和 hi，圈出目标还可能在的那一段。这里用的是闭区间：lo 和 hi 都在区间里，所以一开始是从 0 到最后一个下标，lo 等于 hi 时区间里还有一个元素。
每一轮，mid 是中间的下标。那里正好是目标，结束。太小了，目标只可能在它右边，左端就移到 mid 之后；太大了，右端就移到 mid 之前。两种情况 mid 自己都离开区间。把它留在区间里，两个元素的区间可能让 mid 永远落在同一格——死循环。
lo 越过 hi 时区间空了，目标不在：−1。每一步把区间砍掉一半，所以时间是 O(log n)。演示里十个元素的列表最多比四次；一千个元素也最多比十次。
演示里 41 在下标 7 找到，3 在下标 0、67 在下标 9（两端）；20 落在 15 与 21 之间，不在；空列表直接得 −1，连循环都不进，因为 hi 一开始就是 −1。有重复值时，这个版本交回的是 mid 先碰上的那一个，不一定是第一个——那个问题交给「二分查找第一个出现的位置」。

lineNotes.en: Floor division keeps mid a whole-number index; with an even-sized range it picks the left one of the two middle places.
lineNotes.zh: 整除让 mid 保持整数下标；区间长度为偶数时，它取两个中间位置里靠左的那个。

lineNotes.en: Too big: the target can only be left of mid, and mid itself is ruled out.
lineNotes.zh: 太大：目标只可能在 mid 左边，mid 自己也排除了。

blurb.en: The same algorithm with the loop taken out: the range still in play is passed down as two arguments until it is empty.
blurb.zh: 同一个算法，去掉了循环：还在考虑的区间作为两个实参往下传，直到它变空。

en: Binary search splits naturally into a smaller problem of the same shape: after one comparison, what is left is "search this half of the list" - which is exactly what the function already does. So instead of changing lo and hi in a loop, it calls itself with the new lo and hi. The mechanics of recursion are on the Recursion page; here it is only used.

The base case is the empty range, lo past hi: nothing is left, so the answer is -1. The other stopping point is a hit at mid. Every other call makes the range at least one item shorter, so the base case is always reached. Compare it line by line with Binary Search with a Loop: the loop condition has turned into the base case, and each assignment to lo or hi has turned into a call.
Each recursive call is written after return, so its answer is passed straight back up the chain unchanged - the index found at the bottom arrives at the top.

hi cannot default to len(items) - 1, because a default is worked out once, when def runs, and knows nothing about the list. So it defaults to None and the first call replaces it. The depth of the recursion is about log2 of the length - at most five calls deep for the ten ages, counting the one that finds the range empty - so there is no danger of RecursionError. The demo gives the same answers as the loop version: 7, 0, 9, -1 and -1.
zh: 二分查找天然地分成一个形状相同的更小问题：比过一次之后，剩下的是「在这一半里找」——这正是这个函数本来就在做的事。所以不在循环里改 lo 和 hi，而是带着新的 lo 和 hi 调用自己。递归的机制见「递归」一页；这里只是用它。
基例是空区间，lo 越过了 hi：什么都不剩了，答案是 −1。另一个停下的地方是在 mid 命中。其余每一次调用都让区间至少短一个元素，所以一定会走到基例。拿它和「二分查找：循环版」逐行对照：循环条件变成了基例，每一次给 lo 或 hi 赋值都变成了一次调用。
每一次递归调用都写在 return 后面，所以它的答案原样一层层往上交——最底下找到的下标，就是最顶上拿到的下标。
hi 不能默认成 len(items) - 1，因为默认值在 def 执行时只算一次，根本不知道列表是哪个。所以它默认为 None，第一次调用时再换成真值。递归深度大约是长度的以 2 为底的对数——十个年龄最多五层调用，连最后那次发现区间已空的也算上——不会碰上 RecursionError。演示的答案与循环版相同：7、0、9、−1、−1。

lineNotes.en: Only the outermost call gets here with hi missing; every recursive call passes hi explicitly.
lineNotes.zh: 只有最外层那次调用会带着缺省的 hi 走到这里；每一次递归调用都显式传 hi。

lineNotes.en: The same middle index as in the loop version.
lineNotes.zh: 与循环版相同的中间下标。

blurb.en: The standard library does the halving: bisect_left says where the target would go, and one check says whether it is already there.
blurb.zh: 标准库替你折半：bisect_left 说出目标该插在哪，再查一次那一格是不是它。

en: bisect_left(items, target) runs a binary search on a sorted list and answers a slightly different question: at which index would target have to be inserted to keep the list sorted? If target is already in the list, that index is where its first copy sits. If not, it is where target would go - which is not a match.

So one more check turns the insertion point into a search result: the item at that index must be exactly target. The insertion point can be len(items), one past the end, when target is bigger than everything; reading items there would raise IndexError. That is why the bounds check comes first, joined with and: and stops as soon as its left side is false, so the index is never read.

In the demo, 41 has insertion point 7 and the item there is 41: found. 20 has insertion point 4, but the item there is 21: not found. 70 has insertion point 10, the length of the list, and the bounds check stops it before any reading. 1 has insertion point 0, where the item is 3. The time is O(log n), the same as a hand-written binary search - the bisect module is written in C, so it is faster by a constant factor.
Because it gives the first position, this version gives the first copy when there are repeats, like Binary Search for the First Match.
zh: bisect_left(items, target) 在有序列表上做二分查找，回答的是一个略微不同的问题：要保持有序，target 该插在哪个下标？target 已经在表里时，这个下标就是它第一个副本所在的位置；不在时，是它该去的位置——那里不是它。
所以再加一次检查，就把插入点变成查找结果：那个下标上的元素必须正好是 target。target 比所有元素都大时，插入点可以是 len(items)，表尾再往后一格；去取那里的元素会抛 IndexError。所以越界检查写在前面、用 and 连起来：and 左边一不成立就停，下标根本不会被读。
演示里 41 的插入点是 7，那里正是 41：找到。20 的插入点是 4，那里却是 21：没找到。70 的插入点是 10，等于列表长度，越界检查在读之前就把它拦下了。1 的插入点是 0，那里是 3。时间是 O(log n)，与手写的二分相同——bisect 模块是用 C 写的，快的只是常数倍。
因为它给的是第一个位置，有重复时这个版本交回的就是第一个副本，与「二分查找第一个出现的位置」一样。

lineNotes.en: bisect is in the standard library - nothing to install.
lineNotes.zh: bisect 在标准库里——不用安装。

title.en: Binary Search for the First Match
title.zh: 二分查找第一个出现的位置

blurb.en: With repeats in the list, a hit is not the end: keep squeezing the range from the right until it closes on the first copy.
blurb.zh: 表里有重复时，命中还不算完：继续从右边收拢区间，直到它合拢在第一个副本上。

en: The classic binary search stops at the first hit, and with repeats that hit can be any of the copies. To find the first one, a match must not stop the search. The trick is to change what the range means: here it is half-open, lo is inside it and hi is the first place just past it. It starts as the whole list, 0 up to the length, and is empty as soon as lo equals hi.

Each step asks only one question: is items[mid] smaller than the target? If so, the first copy must be to the right of mid, and lo jumps past it. Otherwise items[mid] is the target or bigger, so the first copy is at mid or to its left - and hi comes down to mid, keeping mid as a possible answer. There is no equality test inside the loop at all.

The loop ends when lo meets hi, and lo is then the first place whose item is not smaller than the target. That place holds the target only if the target is in the list, so one last check after the loop decides - and, as with bisect_left, it must first make sure lo is not past the end. This loop is exactly the one inside the standard library's bisect_left.

In the demo, 55 appears four times and the first is at index 1; 70 twice, first at 6; 40 at index 0. 60 is missing - the loop closes at index 5, where the item is 62. 99 is bigger than everything, so lo ends at 9, the length, and the bounds check answers -1. The time is O(log n), even when every item is a copy of the target.
zh: 经典的二分一命中就停，有重复时这一下命中可能落在任何一个副本上。要找第一个，命中就不能停。诀窍是换掉区间的含义：这里用半开区间，lo 在区间里，hi 是区间右边第一个不在里面的位置。一开始是整张表，从 0 到长度；lo 一等于 hi，区间就空了。
每一步只问一个问题：items[mid] 比目标小吗？是，第一个副本一定在 mid 右边，lo 跳过它；否则 items[mid] 就是目标或者更大，第一个副本在 mid 或它左边——hi 收到 mid，mid 仍留作可能的答案。循环里根本没有相等的判断。
lo 与 hi 碰头时循环结束，此时 lo 是第一个「元素不比目标小」的位置。只有目标在表里，那个位置上才是目标，所以循环后再查一次来定——而且和 bisect_left 一样，先要确认 lo 没有越过表尾。这个循环正是标准库 bisect_left 里面的那一个。
演示里 55 出现四次，第一个在下标 1；70 两次，第一个在 6；40 在下标 0。60 不在——循环合拢在下标 5，那里是 62。99 比谁都大，lo 停在 9，也就是长度，越界检查答 −1。时间 O(log n)，哪怕每个元素都是目标的副本。

lineNotes.en: The only comparison in the loop - no equality test, so a match never stops it early.
lineNotes.zh: 循环里唯一的比较——没有相等判断，所以命中不会让它提前停。

lineNotes.at: if lo < len(items) and items[lo] == target:
lineNotes.en: lo can be the length of the list when the target is bigger than everything - check that before reading items[lo].
lineNotes.zh: 目标比所有元素都大时 lo 可以等于列表长度——先查这个，再读 items[lo]。

title.en: Counting in a Sorted List with bisect
title.zh: 用 bisect 数有序表里的出现次数

blurb.en: Two binary searches find where a run of equal values starts and where it ends; the count is the gap between them.
blurb.zh: 两次二分查找找出一串相等值从哪开始、到哪结束；次数就是两者之差。

en: In a sorted list all copies of a value sit next to each other in one run. bisect_left gives the index where that run starts; bisect_right gives the index just after it ends - on equal items it moves to the right instead of the left. The number of places from one to the other is the number of copies.
If the value is missing, both functions give the same insertion point and the difference is 0. No special case is needed.

list.count walks the whole list: O(n). Two binary searches cost O(log n) each, so this version is O(log n) - on a sorted list of a million numbers, about forty comparisons instead of a million. The catch is that the list has to be sorted already; sorting it first would cost more than one count.

The demo counts each face of a die in ten throws. Face 3 runs from index 3 up to index 7, so it appears 4 times. Faces 1 and 6 appear twice each, 2 and 5 once, and face 4 not at all: both edges are 7, and the difference is 0.
zh: 有序列表里，一个值的所有副本挨在一起，连成一段。bisect_left 给出这一段开始的下标；bisect_right 给出它结束之后那一格的下标——遇到相等的元素，它往右走而不是往左。从一个到另一个有几个位置，就有几个副本。
值不在时，两个函数给出同一个插入点，差是 0。不需要任何特殊情况。
list.count 要走遍整张表：O(n)。两次二分各 O(log n)，所以这个版本是 O(log n)——一百万个数的有序表，大约四十次比较，而不是一百万次。代价是列表必须事先排好；为了数一次先去排序，花的比数一遍还多。
演示数的是掷十次骰子里每一面出现几次。第 3 面从下标 3 到下标 7，出现 4 次。第 1、6 面各两次，第 2、5 面各一次，第 4 面一次也没有：两个边界都是 7，差为 0。

lineNotes.en: The two functions differ only in which way they go when they meet an equal item.
lineNotes.zh: 两个函数只差在遇到相等元素时往哪边走。

blurb.en: The exam-paper trace table, printed by the program itself: one row per comparison with lo, mid, hi, the item looked at and what it decided.
blurb.zh: 考卷上的追踪表，由程序自己打印：每比较一次一行——lo、mid、hi、看的那个元素、做出的决定。

en: Exam questions on binary search usually ask you to complete a trace table: the values of lo, mid and hi at each step and which way the search went. This program prints that table. Each row is printed before lo or hi changes, so it shows the range that was actually looked at in that step.
Searching the ten ages for 41 takes two rows. First lo 0, hi 9, mid 4: the item is 21, too small, so lo becomes 5. Then lo 5, hi 9, mid 7: the item is 41, found - the answer is index 7.

Searching for 20 takes four rows. mid 4 gives 21, too big, so hi becomes 3. Then mid 1 gives 8, too small, lo becomes 2; mid 2 gives 12, too small, lo becomes 3; mid 3 gives 15, too small, lo becomes 4. Now lo is 4 and hi is 3, the range is empty, and the last row says not found. Four comparisons for ten items - about log2 of 10, as expected.

Notice that after the failed search lo is 4: the index where 20 would have to be inserted. The empty range always closes on the insertion point, which is how bisect_left can answer where a missing value would go.
The numbers are lined up with a width in the f-string: :>3 prints a number right-aligned in three characters, so the columns stay straight.
zh: 考二分查找的题目常让你补全一张追踪表：每一步 lo、mid、hi 的值，以及查找往哪边走。这个程序把这张表打印出来。每一行都在 lo 或 hi 改变之前打印，所以它显示的是这一步真正看过的那个区间。
在十个年龄里找 41，一共两行。先是 lo 0、hi 9、mid 4：元素是 21，太小，lo 变成 5。然后 lo 5、hi 9、mid 7：元素是 41，找到——答案是下标 7。
找 20 一共四行。mid 4 是 21，太大，hi 变成 3。接着 mid 1 是 8，太小，lo 变成 2；mid 2 是 12，太小，lo 变成 3；mid 3 是 15，太小，lo 变成 4。这时 lo 是 4、hi 是 3，区间空了，最后一行写着没找到。十个元素比了四次——大约是 10 以 2 为底的对数，正如预期。
注意没找到之后 lo 是 4：正是 20 该插进去的下标。空区间总是合拢在插入点上，bisect_left 就是这样回答「缺席的值该放在哪」的。
数字靠 f-string 里的宽度对齐：:>3 把一个数右对齐印在三个字符宽里，各列才能竖直对齐。

lineNotes.en: Read the middle item once and reuse it for the comparison and the printout.
lineNotes.zh: 中间的元素只取一次，比较和打印都用它。

lineNotes.en: After the loop lo is past hi; there is no mid and no item, so those columns get a dash.
lineNotes.zh: 循环结束后 lo 已经越过 hi；没有 mid、也没有元素，这两列印一个短横。

run.expect:
target 41
 lo mid  hi  items[mid]  result
  0   4   9          21  too small
  5   7   9          41  found

target 20
 lo mid  hi  items[mid]  result
  0   4   9          21  too big
  0   1   3           8  too small
  2   2   3          12  too small
  3   3   3          15  too small
  4   -   3           -  not found

title.en: Hash Table Search with Linear Probing

blurb.en: A fixed-size table where the key itself says where to look: key % SIZE picks the slot, a collision moves on to the next free one, and an empty slot ends the search.
blurb.zh: 一张定长的表，由键自己说出该去哪找：key % SIZE 选格子，冲突就挪到下一个空格，探到空格查找就结束。

en: A hash table turns a key into a place. The hash function here is the simplest one there is: key % SIZE, the remainder after dividing by the table size, which is always a slot number from 0 to 10. To look a key up you go straight to that slot instead of scanning the whole list - on average a constant number of steps, O(1), however many keys there are.

Two different keys can have the same remainder: a collision. Linear probing handles it by trying the next slot, then the next, wrapping from slot 10 back to slot 0, until a free one turns up. In the demo, 14, 36, 47 and 3 all hash to slot 3: 14 gets it, 36 goes on to slot 4, 47 to slot 5 and 3 to slot 6. 21 and 32 both hash to slot 10; 21 gets it and 32 wraps round to slot 0.

Searching follows the same path as inserting. Start at target % SIZE; if the slot holds the target, found; if it holds something else, probe on. An empty slot settles it: had the target been inserted, it would have stopped there or earlier. In the demo, 47 is found after three slots and 32 after wrapping round. 25 starts at slot 3 and probes 3, 4, 5 and 6 before hitting the empty slot 7: not there. 43 starts at slot 10, wraps to 0 and 1, and stops at the empty slot 2. The last column is Python's own in on the list of keys, and it agrees every time.

Two warnings. The table must always keep at least one empty slot: in a full table neither loop would ever meet None and both would run forever. And a key cannot simply be deleted by writing None back, because that would cut the probe path of any key inserted after it - real tables mark deleted slots instead. Long runs of full slots (clusters) slow both insert and search down, which is why real tables grow before they get too full. Python's own dict and set are hash tables too, with a cleverer hash function and probe order.
zh: 哈希表把一个键变成一个位置。这里的哈希函数是最简单的那种：key % SIZE，除以表长的余数，一定是 0 到 10 之间的一个格子号。查一个键就直接去那一格，不必扫整张表——平均只要常数步，O(1)，键再多也一样。
两个不同的键可能余数相同：这叫冲突。线性探测的处理办法是试下一格、再下一格，从 10 号格绕回 0 号格，直到遇上空格。演示里 14、36、47、3 的哈希值都是 3：14 占了 3 号格，36 往后到 4 号，47 到 5 号，3 到 6 号。21 和 32 的哈希值都是 10；21 占了 10 号格，32 绕回到 0 号格。

查找走的是和插入同一条路。从 target % SIZE 出发；那一格是目标，找到；是别的键，接着往后探。探到空格就能下结论：目标若插入过，一定停在这里或更早的地方。演示里 47 看了三格才找到，32 绕了一圈才找到。25 从 3 号格出发，探过 3、4、5、6 号，撞上空的 7 号格：不在。43 从 10 号格出发，绕到 0 号、1 号，停在空的 2 号格。最后一列是 Python 自己对键列表做的 in，每一次都与它一致。
两点警告。表里永远要留至少一个空格：表满了，两个循环都永远遇不到 None，会一直转下去。删除一个键也不能简单地写回 None，那会截断在它之后插入的键的探测路径——真正的哈希表改为给删掉的格子做记号。连成一长串的满格（聚集）会拖慢插入与查找，所以真正的哈希表在太满之前就会扩容。Python 自己的 dict 和 set 也是哈希表，只是哈希函数与探测顺序更讲究。

lineNotes.en: None marks an empty slot - it can never be a key, unlike 0.
lineNotes.zh: None 标记空格——它不可能是一个键，0 却可能是。

lineNotes.en: The hash function: the remainder after dividing by the table size.
lineNotes.zh: 哈希函数：除以表长的余数。

lineNotes.en: Build a fresh table and search it - the list of keys is only read, never changed.
lineNotes.zh: 新建一张表再查——键列表只读不改。

run.expect:
[32, 23, None, 14, 36, 47, 3, None, None, 9, 21]
9 9 True True
47 3 True True
32 10 True True
25 3 False False
43 10 False False
